## New
- **Start with Windows:** a setting in the tray menu (right-click the shield icon). It is off by default and only affects your Windows user; no admin rights are needed.
- **Handles GitHub's hourly limit.** GitHub allows 60 requests per hour without an account. The app now uses fewer requests (a mod usually needs one or none; checking 9 mods used 5), keeps track of the limit, and stops just before it. Mods it could not compare yet show "Waiting for GitHub" instead of an error, and are compared automatically once the limit resets.
- **For testers:** a [testing guide](https://github.com/KDanielK/CS2ModVerifier/blob/main/TESTING.md) and a bug report form for issues.

## Download and verify
Download `CS2ModVerifier-v0.1.2-win-x64.zip`, extract it, and run `CS2ModVerifier.exe`. Nothing needs to be installed.

This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tagged commit. To check that your download is that build:

```
gh attestation verify CS2ModVerifier.exe --repo KDanielK/CS2ModVerifier
```

Or compare the SHA-256 hash (`Get-FileHash CS2ModVerifier.exe`, or `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`) with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

The exe is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn that it is from an unknown publisher. Check it with one of the methods above, then choose "More info" and "Run anyway".

## Please note
CS2 Mod Verifier is an aid, not a guarantee of safety. No findings does not mean a mod is safe, and a finding does not mean a mod is harmful. See the README for what each check does and does not show.
